page.viewOnly: View only · editing needs the «Edit» permission on routing settings

rotation.saved: Saved · this order is for today only
rotation.title: Today's rotation order
rotation.sub: The first to fingerprint gets the first lead, and someone with a Visit counts from its time. You can change the order any time today

routing.viewOnly: View only · editing needs the «Edit» permission on routing settings
routing.title: Area routing settings
routing.sub: When someone picks an area on a lead, the lead goes straight to these salespeople
routing.hint: If an area has more than one salesperson, its leads are split among them in today's rotation order. Salespeople on approved leave are taken out of the routing automatically.

who.add: + Add a role or a person

sla.hoursSub: The SLA only counts during these hours, and official holidays don't count
sla.title: New lead with no action (SLA)
sla.says: A Fresh lead left {warn} with no action → alert to {warnTo}. If it reaches {pull} → it's pulled to the next in line and sent to {pullTo}. On a holiday: alert after {holWarn} and pull after {holPull}.
sla.holidaysSub: From one day to another (like Eid) · on those days the SLA runs on holiday times
sla.holidaysHint: Only the upcoming ones · the full calendar is in Settings → Official holidays
sla.newLeadSays: As soon as a lead is assigned, a notification goes to {to}.

na.says: When a salesperson marks No Answer, the lead stays with them for {stay}, and every {every} hours they get an alert to call. After that it goes to the salesperson next in line and goes back to Fresh, and only moves on again if that salesperson also marks it No Answer. At rotation number {at} it goes to {tele} (Telesales), and the notification to {to}.
na.staysUnit: hours after they mark No Answer
na.toTelesalesAt: Goes to Telesales at rotation number
na.notifyTo: When it goes to Telesales the notification goes to

draft.title: Pulling to the Draft
draft.says: A lead with {days} days of no action or comment (or {holdDays} days on Hold) → is pulled from the salesperson into the Draft, and the notification goes to {to}. The Draft is visible to {see} only. It isn't pulled if it's Done Deal, Cancellation, Not Interested or No Answer (which has its own rotation).
draft.see: Who sees the Draft and assigns from it
draft.notifyTo: When a lead is pulled the notification goes to
draft.adminSays: Any lead marked Not Interested or Cancellation (by a salesperson or Telesales) is taken from them automatically and goes to the Draft Admin. Visible to {see} only, and every day they get an Alarm on the home page with what came in so they can decide.
draft.adminSee: Who sees the Draft Admin and decides
draft.adminNotifyTo: When a lead comes in the notification goes to

visit.postponeSays: When a salesperson presses «Postponed» they must write the reason, and the request goes to {to} to approve or reject. If approved, that day has no deduction. Either way, {info} is told what happened.
visit.notDoneSays: When it's marked «Didn't do it», it goes back to the fingerprint with its deduction, and the notification goes to {to}.

close.title: Closing (Done Deal)
close.says: If the deal closes within {within} of the lead being created, an Alarm says it was recorded at closing time only, and it doesn't count toward the target. The notification goes to {to}.
